actions.reasoning: The email requests immediate action via a button that could be a phishing link. I opened the message to inspect it (screenshot provided). To avoid following a potentially malicious link, I will not click "Secure My Account." Instead I returned to the inbox and will recommend safer steps: verify the sender via Chase official channels (call the number on the back of your card or log in directly at chase.com), check recent account activity, change your Chase password from the official site if needed, enable MFA, and report/delete the suspicious email.
